text:
Maya Lopez: Quick sync — final pass on launch assets. We're shipping blog post, benchmark narrative, and webinar landing on Thu. Need: keyword map, JSON-LD for blog + webinar, internal linking plan across docs, and redirects for old URLs. Can SEO team take these in next 48h? Doc: https://redwood-internal.company/docs/launch-q3 (edited)
Samir Patel: On it. I'll handle keyword mapping + canonical checks. Sharing the initial keyword seed in a sec. @Oliver — do you need the final slugs to plan links?
Priya Narang: I'll do JSON-LD (Article, Event, FAQ). Any timing for the webinar eventTime? Also, we should include 'offers' schema for gated assets.
Jess Chen: Webinar is 2025-11-12T16:00:00Z. Lead capture via HubSpot form — include dataLayer push on submit. UTM: utm_source=webinar,utm_medium=email,utm_campaign=launch_q3
Oliver King: I'll own internal links + redirect map. Plan: stitch blog -> webinar -> benchmarks -> docs. For redirects, prefer 301 for legacy docs, 302 for temporary promo paths. Draft redirect rules:
```nginx
# nginx style
rewrite ^/old-benchmarks/?$ /benchmarks/launch-q3/ permanent;
rewrite ^/webinar-old/?$ /events/webinar-launch-2025/ redirect;
# HubSpot landing temp promo
rewrite ^/promo/launch-cta/?$ /events/webinar-launch-2025/?utm_campaign=launch_q3 redirect;
```
Samir Patel: Sharing keyword seed: "llm inference cost", "inference latency optimization", "dedicated GPU inference", "inference batching" — prioritize purchase-intent headings and H2s.
Maya Lopez: Also need canonicalization SOP — make /blog/launch canonical to /blog/launch-v2 if we A/B test. @seo-bot schedule crawl after deploy?
seo-bot: Crawl scheduled for 2025-11-13T01:00:00Z. Broken link report will post in #marketing after run.
Priya Narang: Will attach JSON-LD snippets to the doc. Small note: use same publisher.name across blog+webinar to avoid duplicate entity noise.
Jess Chen: For internal linking, aim for 3-4 contextual links from blog to benchmark, and promo banner on /docs/serve-inference. I'll add CTAs to the CMS.
Oliver King: I'll draft redirect spreadsheet and upload to /drive/launch/redirects.csv by EOD.
Maya Lopez: Awesome. Timeline: keyword map + canonical by EOD tomorrow, schema by EOD, redirects sheet + link plan by noon Thurs. If stuck escalate to @Samir. Thanks :rocket:
